name: text-stroke
summary: Outlines text using the webkit text-stroke properties.

arguments.name: $fallback-color
accepts: a colour for browsers without text-stroke
each colour accepts a colour, currentColor, a system colour, a function such as var() or light-dark(), a CSS-wide keyword, or null to leave its declaration out

arguments.name: $color
accepts: a word that is not a colour, a quoted colour, a length or two colours are refused
